visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled short hair wearing a navy blue and white plaid shirt stands in a studio, holding a small pink translucent perfume bottle in his right hand. He gestures with his left hand while speaking excitedly against a background of white geometric wall panels. (2) The camera cuts to a woman in a white KENZO sweatshirt and a man in a black hoodie who react with wide eyes and exaggerated expressions of shock and curiosity. (3) Back to the man in the plaid shirt, he gestures with both hands as if describing the texture of an object while continuing his lively explanation. (4) The scene shifts to two women sitting on a colorful studio set; one laughs while covering her mouth, and the other smiles widely. (5) The man in plaid begins spraying the perfume towards a woman in a black and white striped top, creating a visible fine mist in the air. A man in a floral shirt sits nearby and leans his head back to smell the atmosphere. (6) The man in plaid approaches the woman in the white sweatshirt and sprays a large amount of the liquid directly in front of her face. She waves her hands through the mist and laughs. (7) Various close-up shots show the hosts and guests smelling their arms and the air, laughing and clapping in a high-energy, brightly lit studio environment filled with colorful furniture and decorative plants.
